name: qlib158-WVMA_10
description: qlib Alpha158 — ts_std(|close/ref(close,1)-1|*volume, w) / ts_mean(|close/ref(close,1)-1|*volume, w)  (window=10)

computation_data.function_code:
def calculate(data, **kwargs):
    return ts_std((data['close'] / (ref(data['close'], 1) + EPS) - 1.0).abs() * data['volume'], 10) / (ts_mean((data['close'] / (ref(data['close'], 1) + EPS) - 1.0).abs() * data['volume'], 10) + EPS)
